final: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rentals FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS avg_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rentals) AS avg_rentals_above_overall, AVG(rr.rentals - o.avg_rentals) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM rating_rentals rr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rr.rentals > o.avg_rentals
